055  /**
056   * Creates a new Metrics instance.
057   *
058   * @param plugin Your plugin instance.
059   * @param serviceId The id of the service. It can be found at <a
060   *     href="https://bstats.org/what-is-my-plugin-id">What is my plugin id?</a>
061   */
062  public Metrics(Plugin plugin, int serviceId) {
063    this.plugin = plugin;
064    // Get the config file
065    File bStatsFolder = new File(plugin.getDataFolder().getParentFile(), "bStats");
066    File configFile = new File(bStatsFolder, "config.yml");
067    YamlConfiguration config = YamlConfiguration.loadConfiguration(configFile);
068    if (!config.isSet("serverUuid")) {
069      config.addDefault("enabled", true);
070      config.addDefault("serverUuid", UUID.randomUUID().toString());
071      config.addDefault("logFailedRequests", false);
072      config.addDefault("logSentData", false);
073      config.addDefault("logResponseStatusText", false);
074      // Inform the server owners about bStats
075      config
076          .options()
077          .header(
078              "bStats (https://bStats.org) collects some basic information for plugin authors, like how\n"
079                  + "many people use their plugin and their total player count. It's recommended to keep bStats\n"
080                  + "enabled, but if you're not comfortable with this, you can turn this setting off. There is no\n"
081                  + "performance penalty associated with having metrics enabled, and data sent to bStats is fully\n"
082                  + "anonymous.\n"
083                  + "Learn more here: https://bstats.org/docs/server-owners")
084          .copyDefaults(true);
085      try {
086        config.save(configFile);
087      } catch (IOException ignored) {
088      }
089    }
090    // Load the data
091    boolean enabled = config.getBoolean("enabled", true);
092    String serverUUID = config.getString("serverUuid");
093    boolean logErrors = config.getBoolean("logFailedRequests", false);
094    boolean logSentData = config.getBoolean("logSentData", false);
095    boolean logResponseStatusText = config.getBoolean("logResponseStatusText", false);
096    boolean isFolia = false;
097    try {
098      isFolia = Class.forName("io.papermc.paper.threadedregions.RegionizedServer") != null;
099    } catch (Exception e) {
100    }
101    metricsBase =
102        new // See https://github.com/Bastian/bstats-metrics/pull/126
103        // See https://github.com/Bastian/bstats-metrics/pull/126
104        // See https://github.com/Bastian/bstats-metrics/pull/126
105        // See https://github.com/Bastian/bstats-metrics/pull/126
106        // See https://github.com/Bastian/bstats-metrics/pull/126
107        // See https://github.com/Bastian/bstats-metrics/pull/126
108        // See https://github.com/Bastian/bstats-metrics/pull/126
109        MetricsBase(
110            "bukkit",
111            serverUUID,
112            serviceId,
113            enabled,
114            this::appendPlatformData,
115            this::appendServiceData,
116            isFolia
117                ? null
118                : submitDataTask -> Bukkit.getScheduler().runTask(plugin, submitDataTask),
119            plugin::isEnabled,
120            (message, error) -> this.plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING, message, error),
121            (message) -> this.plugin.getLogger().log(Level.INFO, message),
122            logErrors,
123            logSentData,
124            logResponseStatusText,
125            false);
126  }

142  private void appendPlatformData(JsonObjectBuilder builder) {
143    builder.appendField("playerAmount", getPlayerAmount());
144    builder.appendField("onlineMode", Bukkit.getOnlineMode() ? 1 : 0);
145    builder.appendField("bukkitVersion", Bukkit.getVersion());
146    builder.appendField("bukkitName", Bukkit.getName());
147    builder.appendField("javaVersion", System.getProperty("java.version"));
148    builder.appendField("osName", System.getProperty("os.name"));
149    builder.appendField("osArch", System.getProperty("os.arch"));
150    builder.appendField("osVersion", System.getProperty("os.version"));
151    builder.appendField("coreCount", Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors());
152  }
153
154  private void appendServiceData(JsonObjectBuilder builder) {
155    builder.appendField("pluginVersion", plugin.getDescription().getVersion());
156  }
157
158  private int getPlayerAmount() {
159    try {
160      // Around MC 1.8 the return type was changed from an array to a collection,
161      // This fixes java.lang.NoSuchMethodError:
162      // org.bukkit.Bukkit.getOnlinePlayers()Ljava/util/Collection;
163      Method onlinePlayersMethod = Class.forName("org.bukkit.Server").getMethod("getOnlinePlayers");
164      return onlinePlayersMethod.getReturnType().equals(Collection.class)
165          ? ((Collection<?>) onlinePlayersMethod.invoke(Bukkit.getServer())).size()
166          : ((Player[]) onlinePlayersMethod.invoke(Bukkit.getServer())).length;
167    } catch (Exception e) {
168      // Just use the new method if the reflection failed
169      return Bukkit.getOnlinePlayers().size();
170    }
171  }

173  public static class MetricsBase {
174
175    /** The version of the Metrics class. */
176    public static final String METRICS_VERSION = "3.2.1";
177
178    private static final String REPORT_URL = "https://bStats.org/api/v2/data/%s";
179
180    private final ScheduledExecutorService scheduler;
181
182    private final String platform;
183
184    private final String serverUuid;
185
186    private final int serviceId;
187
188    private final Consumer<JsonObjectBuilder> appendPlatformDataConsumer;
189
190    private final Consumer<JsonObjectBuilder> appendServiceDataConsumer;
191
192    private final Consumer<Runnable> submitTaskConsumer;
193
194    private final Supplier<Boolean> checkServiceEnabledSupplier;
195
196    private final BiConsumer<String, Throwable> errorLogger;
197
198    private final Consumer<String> infoLogger;
199
200    private final boolean logErrors;
201
202    private final boolean logSentData;
203
204    private final boolean logResponseStatusText;
205
206    private final Set<CustomChart> customCharts = new HashSet<>();
207
208    private final boolean enabled;
209
210    /**
211     * Creates a new MetricsBase class instance.
212     *
213     * @param platform The platform of the service.
214     * @param serviceId The id of the service.
215     * @param serverUuid The server uuid.
216     * @param enabled Whether or not data sending is enabled.
217     * @param appendPlatformDataConsumer A consumer that receives a {@code JsonObjectBuilder} and
218     *     appends all platform-specific data.
219     * @param appendServiceDataConsumer A consumer that receives a {@code JsonObjectBuilder} and
220     *     appends all service-specific data.
221     * @param submitTaskConsumer A consumer that takes a runnable with the submit task. This can be
222     *     used to delegate the data collection to a another thread to prevent errors caused by
223     *     concurrency. Can be {@code null}.
224     * @param checkServiceEnabledSupplier A supplier to check if the service is still enabled.
225     * @param errorLogger A consumer that accepts log message and an error.
226     * @param infoLogger A consumer that accepts info log messages.
227     * @param logErrors Whether or not errors should be logged.
228     * @param logSentData Whether or not the sent data should be logged.
229     * @param logResponseStatusText Whether or not the response status text should be logged.
230     * @param skipRelocateCheck Whether or not the relocate check should be skipped.
231     */
232    public MetricsBase(
233        String platform,
234        String serverUuid,
235        int serviceId,
236        boolean enabled,
237        Consumer<JsonObjectBuilder> appendPlatformDataConsumer,
238        Consumer<JsonObjectBuilder> appendServiceDataConsumer,
239        Consumer<Runnable> submitTaskConsumer,
240        Supplier<Boolean> checkServiceEnabledSupplier,
241        BiConsumer<String, Throwable> errorLogger,
242        Consumer<String> infoLogger,
243        boolean logErrors,
244        boolean logSentData,
245        boolean logResponseStatusText,
246        boolean skipRelocateCheck) {
247      ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor scheduler =
248          new ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor(
249              1,
250              task -> {
251                Thread thread = new Thread(task, "bStats-Metrics");
252                thread.setDaemon(true);
253                return thread;
254              });
255      // We want delayed tasks (non-periodic) that will execute in the future to be
256      // cancelled when the scheduler is shutdown.
257      // Otherwise, we risk preventing the server from shutting down even when
258      // MetricsBase#shutdown() is called
259      scheduler.setExecuteExistingDelayedTasksAfterShutdownPolicy(false);
260      this.scheduler = scheduler;
261      this.platform = platform;
262      this.serverUuid = serverUuid;
263      this.serviceId = serviceId;
264      this.enabled = enabled;
265      this.appendPlatformDataConsumer = appendPlatformDataConsumer;
266      this.appendServiceDataConsumer = appendServiceDataConsumer;
267      this.submitTaskConsumer = submitTaskConsumer;
268      this.checkServiceEnabledSupplier = checkServiceEnabledSupplier;
269      this.errorLogger = errorLogger;
270      this.infoLogger = infoLogger;
271      this.logErrors = logErrors;
272      this.logSentData = logSentData;
273      this.logResponseStatusText = logResponseStatusText;
274      if (!skipRelocateCheck) {
275        checkRelocation();
276      }
277      if (enabled) {
278        // WARNING: Removing the option to opt-out will get your plugin banned from
279        // bStats
280        startSubmitting();
281      }
282    }
283
284    public void addCustomChart(CustomChart chart) {
285      this.customCharts.add(chart);
286    }
287
288    public void shutdown() {
289      scheduler.shutdown();
290    }
291
292    private void startSubmitting() {
293      final Runnable submitTask =
294          () -> {
295            if (!enabled || !checkServiceEnabledSupplier.get()) {
296              // Submitting data or service is disabled
297              scheduler.shutdown();
298              return;
299            }
300            if (submitTaskConsumer != null) {
301              submitTaskConsumer.accept(this::submitData);
302            } else {
303              this.submitData();
304            }
305          };
306      // Many servers tend to restart at a fixed time at xx:00 which causes an uneven
307      // distribution of requests on the
308      // bStats backend. To circumvent this problem, we introduce some randomness into
309      // the initial and second delay.
310      // WARNING: You must not modify and part of this Metrics class, including the
311      // submit delay or frequency!
312      // WARNING: Modifying this code will get your plugin banned on bStats. Just
313      // don't do it!
314      long initialDelay = (long) (1000 * 60 * (3 + Math.random() * 3));
315      long secondDelay = (long) (1000 * 60 * (Math.random() * 30));
316      scheduler.schedule(submitTask, initialDelay, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
317      scheduler.scheduleAtFixedRate(
318          submitTask, initialDelay + secondDelay, 1000 * 60 * 30, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
319    }
320
321    private void submitData() {
322      final JsonObjectBuilder baseJsonBuilder = new JsonObjectBuilder();
323      appendPlatformDataConsumer.accept(baseJsonBuilder);
324      final JsonObjectBuilder serviceJsonBuilder = new JsonObjectBuilder();
325      appendServiceDataConsumer.accept(serviceJsonBuilder);
326      JsonObjectBuilder.JsonObject[] chartData =
327          customCharts.stream()
328              .map(customChart -> customChart.getRequestJsonObject(errorLogger, logErrors))
329              .filter(Objects::nonNull)
330              .toArray(JsonObjectBuilder.JsonObject[]::new);
331      serviceJsonBuilder.appendField("id", serviceId);
332      serviceJsonBuilder.appendField("customCharts", chartData);
333      baseJsonBuilder.appendField("service", serviceJsonBuilder.build());
334      baseJsonBuilder.appendField("serverUUID", serverUuid);
335      baseJsonBuilder.appendField("metricsVersion", METRICS_VERSION);
336      JsonObjectBuilder.JsonObject data = baseJsonBuilder.build();
337      scheduler.execute(
338          () -> {
339            try {
340              sendData(data);
341            } catch (Exception e) {
342              // Something went wrong! :(
343              if (logErrors) {
344                errorLogger.accept("Could not submit bStats metrics data", e);
345              }
346            }
347          });
348    }
349
350    private void sendData(JsonObjectBuilder.JsonObject data) throws Exception {
351      if (logSentData) {
352        infoLogger.accept("Sent bStats metrics data: " + data.toString());
353      }
354      String url = String.format(REPORT_URL, platform);
355      HttpsURLConnection connection = (HttpsURLConnection) new URL(url).openConnection();
356      // Compress the data to save bandwidth
357      byte[] compressedData = compress(data.toString());
358      connection.setRequestMethod("POST");
359      connection.addRequestProperty("Accept", "application/json");
360      connection.addRequestProperty("Connection", "close");
361      connection.addRequestProperty("Content-Encoding", "gzip");
362      connection.addRequestProperty("Content-Length", String.valueOf(compressedData.length));
363      connection.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json");
364      connection.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Metrics-Service/1");
365      connection.setDoOutput(true);
366      try (DataOutputStream outputStream = new DataOutputStream(connection.getOutputStream())) {
367        outputStream.write(compressedData);
368      }
369      StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
370      try (BufferedReader bufferedReader =
371          new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(connection.getInputStream()))) {
372        String line;
373        while ((line = bufferedReader.readLine()) != null) {
374          builder.append(line);
375        }
376      }
377      if (logResponseStatusText) {
378        infoLogger.accept("Sent data to bStats and received response: " + builder);
379      }
380    }
381
382    /** Checks that the class was properly relocated. */
383    private void checkRelocation() {
384      // You can use the property to disable the check in your test environment
385      if (System.getProperty("bstats.relocatecheck") == null
386          || !System.getProperty("bstats.relocatecheck").equals("false")) {
387        // Maven's Relocate is clever and changes strings, too. So we have to use this
388        // little "trick" ... :D
389        final String defaultPackage =
390            new String(new byte[] {'o', 'r', 'g', '.', 'b', 's', 't', 'a', 't', 's'});
391        final String examplePackage =
392            new String(new byte[] {'y', 'o', 'u', 'r', '.', 'p', 'a', 'c', 'k', 'a', 'g', 'e'});
393        // We want to make sure no one just copy & pastes the example and uses the wrong
394        // package names
395        if (MetricsBase.class.getPackage().getName().startsWith(defaultPackage)
396            || MetricsBase.class.getPackage().getName().startsWith(examplePackage)) {
397          throw new IllegalStateException("bStats Metrics class has not been relocated correctly!");
398        }
399      }
400    }
401
402    /**
403     * Gzips the given string.
404     *
405     * @param str The string to gzip.
406     * @return The gzipped string.
407     */
408    private static byte[] compress(final String str) throws IOException {
409      if (str == null) {
410        return null;
411      }
412      ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
413      try (GZIPOutputStream gzip = new GZIPOutputStream(outputStream)) {
414        gzip.write(str.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
415      }
416      return outputStream.toByteArray();
417    }
418  }

420  public abstract static class CustomChart {
421
422    private final String chartId;
423
424    protected CustomChart(String chartId) {
425      if (chartId == null) {
426        throw new IllegalArgumentException("chartId must not be null");
427      }
428      this.chartId = chartId;
429    }
430
431    public JsonObjectBuilder.JsonObject getRequestJsonObject(
432        BiConsumer<String, Throwable> errorLogger, boolean logErrors) {
433      JsonObjectBuilder builder = new JsonObjectBuilder();
434      builder.appendField("chartId", chartId);
435      try {
436        JsonObjectBuilder.JsonObject data = getChartData();
437        if (data == null) {
438          // If the data is null we don't send the chart.
439          return null;
440        }
441        builder.appendField("data", data);
442      } catch (Throwable t) {
443        if (logErrors) {
444          errorLogger.accept("Failed to get data for custom chart with id " + chartId, t);
445        }
446        return null;
447      }
448      return builder.build();
449    }
450
451    protected abstract JsonObjectBuilder.JsonObject getChartData() throws Exception;
452  }

463     */

465      super(chartId);
466      this.callable = callable;
467    }
468
469    @Override
470    protected JsonObjectBuilder.JsonObject getChartData() throws Exception {
471      int value = callable.call();
472      if (value == 0) {
473        // Null = skip the chart
474        return null;
475      }
476      return new JsonObjectBuilder().appendField("value", value).build();
477    }
478  }

480  public static class DrilldownPie extends CustomChart {
481
482    private final Callable<Map<String, Map<String, Integer>>> callable;
483
484    /**
485     * Class constructor.
486     *
487     * @param chartId The id of the chart.
488     * @param callable The callable which is used to request the chart data.
489     */
490    public DrilldownPie(String chartId, Callable<Map<String, Map<String, Integer>>> callable) {
491      super(chartId);
492      this.callable = callable;
493    }
494
495    @Override
496    public JsonObjectBuilder.JsonObject getChartData() throws Exception {
497      JsonObjectBuilder valuesBuilder = new JsonObjectBuilder();
498      Map<String, Map<String, Integer>> map = callable.call();
499      if (map == null || map.isEmpty()) {
500        // Null = skip the chart
501        return null;
502      }
503      boolean reallyAllSkipped = true;
504      for (Map.Entry<String, Map<String, Integer>> entryValues : map.entrySet()) {
505        JsonObjectBuilder valueBuilder = new JsonObjectBuilder();
506        boolean allSkipped = true;
507        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> valueEntry : map.get(entryValues.getKey()).entrySet()) {
508          valueBuilder.appendField(valueEntry.getKey(), valueEntry.getValue());
509          allSkipped = false;
510        }
511        if (!allSkipped) {
512          reallyAllSkipped = false;
513          valuesBuilder.appendField(entryValues.getKey(), valueBuilder.build());
514        }
515      }
516      if (reallyAllSkipped) {
517        // Null = skip the chart
518        return null;
519      }
520      return new JsonObjectBuilder().appendField("values", valuesBuilder.build()).build();
521    }
522  }

524  public static class AdvancedBarChart extends CustomChart {
525
526    private final Callable<Map<String, int[]>> callable;
527
528    /**
529     * Class constructor.
530     *
531     * @param chartId The id of the chart.
532     * @param callable The callable which is used to request the chart data.
533     */
534    public AdvancedBarChart(String chartId, Callable<Map<String, int[]>> callable) {
535      super(chartId);
536      this.callable = callable;
537    }
538
539    @Override
540    protected JsonObjectBuilder.JsonObject getChartData() throws Exception {
541      JsonObjectBuilder valuesBuilder = new JsonObjectBuilder();
542      Map<String, int[]> map = callable.call();
543      if (map == null || map.isEmpty()) {
544        // Null = skip the chart
545        return null;
546      }
547      boolean allSkipped = true;
548      for (Map.Entry<String, int[]> entry : map.entrySet()) {
549        if (entry.getValue().length == 0) {
550          // Skip this invalid
551          continue;
552        }
553        allSkipped = false;
554        valuesBuilder.appendField(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
555      }
556      if (allSkipped) {
557        // Null = skip the chart
558        return null;
559      }
560      return new JsonObjectBuilder().appendField("values", valuesBuilder.build()).build();
561    }
562  }

683     */
684    public SimplePie(String chartId, Callable<String> callable) {
685      super(chartId);
686      this.callable = callable;
687    }
688
689    @Override
690    protected JsonObjectBuilder.JsonObject getChartData() throws Exception {
691      String value = callable.call();
692      if (value == null || value.isEmpty()) {
693        // Null = skip the chart
694        return null;
695      }
696      return new JsonObjectBuilder().appendField("value", value).build();
697    }
698  }
699
700  /**
701   * An extremely simple JSON builder.
702   *
703   * <p>While this class is neither feature-rich nor the most performant one, it's sufficient enough
704   * for its use-case.
705   */
706  public static class JsonObjectBuilder {
707
708    private StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
709
710    private boolean hasAtLeastOneField = false;
711
712    public JsonObjectBuilder() {
713      builder.append("{");
714    }
715
716    /**
717     * Appends a null field to the JSON.
718     *
719     * @param key The key of the field.
720     * @return A reference to this object.
721     */
722    public JsonObjectBuilder appendNull(String key) {
723      appendFieldUnescaped(key, "null");
724      return this;
725    }
726
727    /**
728     * Appends a string field to the JSON.
729     *
730     * @param key The key of the field.
731     * @param value The value of the field.
732     * @return A reference to this object.
733     */
734    public JsonObjectBuilder appendField(String key, String value) {
735      if (value == null) {
736        throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSON value must not be null");
737      }
738      appendFieldUnescaped(key, "\"" + escape(value) + "\"");
739      return this;
740    }
741
742    /**
743     * Appends an integer field to the JSON.
744     *
745     * @param key The key of the field.
746     * @param value The value of the field.
747     * @return A reference to this object.
748     */
749    public JsonObjectBuilder appendField(String key, int value) {
750      appendFieldUnescaped(key, String.valueOf(value));
751      return this;
752    }
753
754    /**
755     * Appends an object to the JSON.
756     *
757     * @param key The key of the field.
758     * @param object The object.
759     * @return A reference to this object.
760     */
761    public JsonObjectBuilder appendField(String key, JsonObject object) {
762      if (object == null) {
763        throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSON object must not be null");
764      }
765      appendFieldUnescaped(key, object.toString());
766      return this;
767    }
768
769    /**
770     * Appends a string array to the JSON.
771     *
772     * @param key The key of the field.
773     * @param values The string array.
774     * @return A reference to this object.
775     */
776    public JsonObjectBuilder appendField(String key, String[] values) {
777      if (values == null) {
778        throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSON values must not be null");
779      }
780      String escapedValues =
781          Arrays.stream(values)
782              .map(value -> "\"" + escape(value) + "\"")
783              .collect(Collectors.joining(","));
784      appendFieldUnescaped(key, "[" + escapedValues + "]");
785      return this;
786    }
787
788    /**
789     * Appends an integer array to the JSON.
790     *
791     * @param key The key of the field.
792     * @param values The integer array.
793     * @return A reference to this object.
794     */
795    public JsonObjectBuilder appendField(String key, int[] values) {
796      if (values == null) {
797        throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSON values must not be null");
798      }
799      String escapedValues =
800          Arrays.stream(values).mapToObj(String::valueOf).collect(Collectors.joining(","));
801      appendFieldUnescaped(key, "[" + escapedValues + "]");
802      return this;
803    }
804
805    /**
806     * Appends an object array to the JSON.
807     *
808     * @param key The key of the field.
809     * @param values The integer array.
810     * @return A reference to this object.
811     */
812    public JsonObjectBuilder appendField(String key, JsonObject[] values) {
813      if (values == null) {
814        throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSON values must not be null");
815      }
816      String escapedValues =
817          Arrays.stream(values).map(JsonObject::toString).collect(Collectors.joining(","));
818      appendFieldUnescaped(key, "[" + escapedValues + "]");
819      return this;
820    }
821
822    /**
823     * Appends a field to the object.
824     *
825     * @param key The key of the field.
826     * @param escapedValue The escaped value of the field.
827     */
828    private void appendFieldUnescaped(String key, String escapedValue) {
829      if (builder == null) {
830        throw new IllegalStateException("JSON has already been built");
831      }
832      if (key == null) {
833        throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSON key must not be null");
834      }
835      if (hasAtLeastOneField) {
836        builder.append(",");
837      }
838      builder.append("\"").append(escape(key)).append("\":").append(escapedValue);
839      hasAtLeastOneField = true;
840    }
841
842    /**
843     * Builds the JSON string and invalidates this builder.
844     *
845     * @return The built JSON string.
846     */
847    public JsonObject build() {
848      if (builder == null) {
849        throw new IllegalStateException("JSON has already been built");
850      }
851      JsonObject object = new JsonObject(builder.append("}").toString());
852      builder = null;
853      return object;
854    }
855
856    /**
857     * Escapes the given string like stated in https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc4627.txt.
858     *
859     * <p>This method escapes only the necessary characters '"', '\'. and '\u0000' - '\u001F'.
860     * Compact escapes are not used (e.g., '\n' is escaped as "\u000a" and not as "\n").
861     *
862     * @param value The value to escape.
863     * @return The escaped value.
864     */
865    private static String escape(String value) {
866      final StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
867      for (int i = 0; i < value.length(); i++) {
868        char c = value.charAt(i);
869        if (c == '"') {
870          builder.append("\\\"");
871        } else if (c == '\\') {
872          builder.append("\\\\");
873        } else if (c <= '\u000F') {
874          builder.append("\\u000").append(Integer.toHexString(c));
875        } else if (c <= '\u001F') {
876          builder.append("\\u00").append(Integer.toHexString(c));
877        } else {
878          builder.append(c);
879        }
880      }
881      return builder.toString();
882    }
883
884    /**
885     * A super simple representation of a JSON object.
886     *
887     * <p>This class only exists to make methods of the {@link JsonObjectBuilder} type-safe and not
888     * allow a raw string inputs for methods like {@link JsonObjectBuilder#appendField(String,
889     * JsonObject)}.
890     */
891    public static class JsonObject {
892
893      private final String value;
894
895      private JsonObject(String value) {
896        this.value = value;
897      }
898
899      @Override
900      public String toString() {
901        return value;
902      }
903    }
904  }
905}
